div.div: غُبْرُورٌ A certain small bird of the passerine kind, (O, L, K, TA,) dust-coloured: (O, L, TA:) so says AHát in the “ Book of Birds: ” pl. غَبَارِيرٌ: (O:) it is the same as is mentioned in an earlier part of this art. in the K by the name of ↓ غُبْرُون , which is a mistranscription. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
